"Spectacular Riches" has two of two top prizes left and is well into its run. About two-thirds of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

The table below shows the full count for "Spectacular Riches", with every prize level included.
1124.headline: Early stage or late

1125.body:
"$1,000,000 Black Titanium" can match another game on price and top prize and still pay out very differently. This game is a game with most of its money in small, frequent prizes. Of its unclaimed prize money, most is in wins under $1,000 and the rest is in bigger prizes. Neither kind is better, and each suits different players.

Everything here about "$1,000,000 Black Titanium" comes from official Ohio lottery numbers, current through November 24.
1125.headline: Same price, different prizes

1127.body:
On "Triple Tripler", one $1,800 top prize was claimed four days ago. That leaves nineteen of the original twenty. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

The numbers for "Triple Tripler" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
1127.headline: Someone claimed a $1,800 prize

1134.body:
"Crazy Cash" is still new, with most of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

The numbers for "Crazy Cash" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
1134.headline: Where this game is in its run

1140.body:
"$25, $50 or $250" has 593,571 prizes of $25 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $50 prize, with 118,645 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

The numbers for "$25, $50 or $250" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
1140.headline: What's actually left to win

696.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Monopoly 200X", about a quarter are still unsold. The game is well into its run, with two of ten top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Everything above about "Monopoly 200X" comes from the Ohio Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
696.headline: How much has sold

762.body:
The top prize count on "Billion" has not moved since we started watching it. The game still has two of four top prizes unclaimed. Smaller prizes keep getting claimed as tickets sell. The same top prizes are now among fewer tickets.

Tomorrow's count on "Billion" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
762.headline: Top prizes are still unclaimed

827.body:
"50th Anniversary" has 266,979 prizes of $100 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $1 million prize, with two left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

50th Anniversary's prize setup is not better or worse than any other. Some games pay many small prizes and some pay a few large ones.

If "50th Anniversary" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
827.headline: Prize table details

847.body:
All the top prizes on "Bingo 50X" have been claimed. That lowers the biggest prize from $500,000 to $100,000. Two of those are still out there. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

The numbers for "Bingo 50X" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
847.headline: Big prize shown, none left

891.body:
"Cash Explosion 25X" is in the last part of its run, with only a small slice of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

If "Cash Explosion 25X" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
